source.description:
PROBLEM
At chain completion the operator has N waiting/done specialist jobs (keep-alive executors, reviewers, advisors) that must be torn down one-by-one via 'sp stop <job-id>'. No verb targets jobs of a specific chain — manual filter/copy/paste.

SUCCESS
- 'sp chain stop <chain-id>' terminates all jobs (running, waiting, starting) for one chain; default safe verb
- 'sp stop --all [--dry-run] [--yes]' blast-radius verb with sole-orchestrator refusal (refuses if any 'running' or if jobs span other chain_id) + structured refusal envelope teaching the right verb
- both reuse existing stopJob() (terminal-status-before-SIGTERM, flush handoff)
- using-specialists-v4 SKILL teardown-discipline section
- Claude PreToolUse hook on 'sp stop --all' computes sole-orchestrator predicate, blocks with hint when violated

SCOPE
src/cli/stop.ts (new flag handling), src/specialist/control.ts (shared filter helper), .xtrm/hooks/ (PreToolUse hook), config/skills/using-specialists-v4/SKILL.md (new section), tests.

NON_GOALS
- chain-as-container model (substrate-side)
- modifying per-job sp stop semantics

CONSTRAINTS
- 'sp stop --all' must NEVER touch 'running' jobs
- refusal envelope must structurally point at 'sp chain stop <chain-id>' alternative
- --yes does NOT bypass refusal rule (only skips confirm)

VALIDATION
- sp chain stop on a multi-job chain terminates all its jobs, leaves other chains untouched
- sp stop --all with another chain running → structured refusal + suggested command
- sp stop --all with only waiting/done jobs of one chain → terminates correctly
- PreToolUse hook fires before CLI when --all + other chain present

OUTPUT
2 new CLI verbs + shared predicate + v4 SKILL section + hook + tests + docs

SCRUTINY: medium

PARENT: unitAI-kj651
ROADMAP REF: Opp 13, specialists-roadmap.md §3.2 (Phase 7 polish)

REPLACES: unitAI-heukb (closed wrong-orphan — same scope, mis-filed as standalone feature instead of kj651 child)
